blind.note: Steps younger than 20000 yr (rescaled) are dropped unless the file's [deep.blind] cites a source dating a decline there, which keeps them (grade D). `against`: dropped steps whose mean level is beyond 1.5x from the youngest resolved step, the other way from the join (or the join is flat): said on the card, not drawn.

deep_join.note: How each genomic deep past meets the next level across PSMC's blind spot (ToLaD#77, #80, #71): a cited next level (a history file's baseline or first point) dated 1900 or earlier scales the curve to meet it (rule `scaled`, factor = 1 / ratio); a modelled one (the natural level in 1500 CE, today's modelled count) keeps the genomic level (rule `absolute`). A first cited point after 1900 (a crash or a modern count, not a historical level) is not the deep past's level: the curve is kept, joins the natural level in 1500 CE where the range-loss trend applies (the trend then runs to that point), else that point itself (`cited_late` counts them). ratio = genomic level at the blind spot / next level, before scaling; flagged when beyond 10x either way. Per species: history.species[<sp>].deep.join (its `note` is the card's sentence).

mutation_rate.note: Per-lineage mutation rate per site per year (ToLaD#74, #75): log10 mu_y = a + b log10 G + offset[order], G = the pipeline's generation length (2L, years). Fit over the modelled per-year rates of the pedigree mammals of the source; an order gets an offset (the mean residual of its species) from 2 species. lo / hi = mu x/ 10^band_dex (the 95% prediction band).
